item.title: Fri 23 Oct 2026: Everest claims PwC, AI-key harvesting, PHP2Shell at scale + weekly roll-up
item.description: Everest's unverified PwC claim and the law-firm run (Kirkland & Ellis, Lexitas); Railway and LiteLLM show attackers harvesting AI keys from developer platforms; PHP2Shell hits millions of attempts and an Arista VeloCloud zero-day is exploited. Deep dive: the Microsoft 365 token-spraying campaign. Plus the weekly roll-up for 16-22 Oct. Full sourced brief: https://kitsunayx1.github.io/daily-audio/briefs/2026-10-23.md

item.title: Thu 22 Oct 2026: China's Storm-0940 behind ConnectWise, advisers on leak sites, LiteLLM backdoored
item.description: Microsoft attributes the ConnectWise compromise to China-aligned Storm-0940 using the ARTEX AI agent framework; Sodali, accounting and law firms on leak sites; LiteLLM 1.107.0 backdoored; PHP2Shell exploitation attempts; GitLab CVSS 10 bug; deep dive on Storm-0940. Full sourced brief: https://kitsunayx1.github.io/daily-audio/briefs/2026-10-22.md

item.title: Wed 21 Oct 2026: Ransomware through the VPN, a supply-chain pile-up, PHP2Shell patch day
item.description: Qilin and INC exploit GlobalProtect against professional and legal services; joint advisory on SafePay; ConnectWise, OVHcloud CLI, UpdraftCentral and eMudhra supply-chain incidents; PHP emergency patches; Silent Ransom Group's redacted listings; deep dive on SafePay. Full sourced brief: https://kitsunayx1.github.io/daily-audio/briefs/2026-10-21.md

item.title: Tue 20 Oct 2026: N0n publishes maritime data, law firms on leak sites, ROMULUS fake ChatGPT ClickFix
item.description: N0n posts its first batch of Korean maritime data; Latham & Watkins, Andersen and Baker Donelson on leak sites; Bullhorn staffing platform offline; Plex2Shell exploited; Rank Math PRO backdoor; deep dive on the ROMULUS ClickFix platform. Full sourced brief: https://kitsunayx1.github.io/daily-audio/briefs/2026-10-20.md

item.title: Mon 19 Oct 2026: ConnectWise SkyKick hits Microsoft 365 tenants, BeyondTrust zero-day, maritime leak deadline
item.description: 72-hour weekend window. A stolen ConnectWise Cloud Backup (SkyKick) app credential used to access 160+ Microsoft 365 tenants, with law firms and policy, trade and critical-minerals organisations targeted; China-linked ARMORY CASTLE's BeyondTrust Remote Support zero-day (KEV deadline today); N0n maritime publication due today with CyberLogitec named as likely supplier; Canva third-party incident; AI agents reaching live systems unnoticed; Silent Ransom Group playbook; Starshield and Russia sanctions waiver. Full sourced brief: https://kitsunayx1.github.io/daily-audio/briefs/2026-10-19.md

item.title: Fri 16 Oct 2026: Contractors as the breach, appliance deadlines, spyware via ads, plus the week in review
item.description: BAE Systems incident halts US bankruptcy court notices; Senture takes down a DOT contact centre; AhsayCBS backup console exploited and in KEV; Ivanti deadline today; zero-click Candiru spyware delivered through ads; Poole Group confirms; UK Legal Aid data back to 1978; deep dive on AI-assisted espionage cluster CL-UNK-1211; and the weekly roll-up for 9-15 Oct. Full sourced brief: https://kitsunayx1.github.io/daily-audio/briefs/2026-10-16.md Weekly roll-up: https://kitsunayx1.github.io/daily-audio/briefs/2026-10-16-weekly.md

item.title: Thu 15 Oct 2026: Edge devices under fire, phishing-kit takedown, ransomware gets personal
item.description: Exploited PAN-OS management flaw, Cisco Secure Email Gateway root via attachment, Ivanti mass scanning; Microsoft takes down CoGUI, Haozi and Iron Man phishing kits; ransomware threats against staff and the Revolut KYC leak; professional-services leak-site claims (possibly Alera Group, unconfirmed); Nextcloud backdoors, XBOW's AI-built Chrome chain; deep dive on the PEERSTITCH FortiGate implant. Full sourced brief: https://kitsunayx1.github.io/daily-audio/briefs/2026-10-15.md

item.title: Wed 14 Oct 2026: Ivanti zero-day chain, record Patch Tuesday, insiders and laptop farms
item.description: Ivanti Connect Secure chain (UTA0576) roots patched VPNs; Microsoft's ~1,400-CVE Patch Tuesday with an exploited Mark-of-the-Web bypass; OpenAI conference-room recorder, DPRK laptop farms and Kimsuky fake invitations; Meta GitHub breach, Ampath, Liberating Research; Fehmarnbelt tunnel attack. Full sourced brief: https://kitsunayx1.github.io/daily-audio/briefs/2026-10-14.md

item.title: Tue 13 Oct 2026: Deloitte leak-site claim, EU retail attacks, help-desk social engineering
item.description: Deloitte listed by The Gentlemen; Ahold Delhaize outage and Danfoss fridge sabotage in French supermarkets; Silent Ransom Group sends agents into law firms; SonicWall, GitLab and Atlassian flaws; CyberXero's AI agents; Yandex strikes and Riyadh airport closure; ShinyHunters deep dive. Full sourced brief: https://kitsunayx1.github.io/daily-audio/briefs/2026-10-13.md
